svg.title: Composition, dispatch, and isolation have separate conditions
svg.desc: This maps composition and settings, not one execution sequence shared by every Agent.
svg.text: Composition, dispatch, and isolation have separate conditions
This maps composition and settings, not one execution sequence shared by every Agent.

g.text: Registry: loadAgentToolRuntime()
Compose authorization, confirmation Store, Runtime descriptors, execution profiles, and the enforcer.
Compose governance wrappers separately from the optional pipeline; check the actual consumers.
Governance wrapper
Tool enablement, input size, authorization, and audit.
Timeouts, cancellation, and result handling.
A wrapper does not establish an enabled full pipeline.
Optional dispatch pipeline
Descriptors, canonical Context, scheduling, rate limits.
Step locks, runners, and structured results.
Separate flags for MATH / DEEP_RESEARCHER / MCP.

svg.text: Below: profile enforcement settings and capabilities, not a mandatory next stage after both boxes.

g.text: ExecutionProfileEnforcer
Check enforcer injection and TOOL_EXECUTION_PROFILE_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED.
Disabled: resolve required secrets, then return disabled. Enabled: check profile reference, version, and runner.
This flag is separate from the source-specific full dispatch pipeline flags.
trusted_in_process
Capability matching directly allows this mode.
This does not establish OS isolation for all resource limits.
Check tool implementations and actual conditions separately.
isolated_process
Requires a runner with profile-matching capabilities.
Missing runner / insufficient capabilities → typed deny.
An ordinary subprocess does not establish isolation.
Pinned-version limits and distinct entry points
Security docs state no production SandboxRunnerPort implementation; test doubles are not deployment guarantees.
Math loadMathCalculatorTool(): pipeline off returns the original calculator; on obtains it from Runtime tools.
Disabling the pipeline retains Registry wrappers; treat the Math direct-import branch separately.
MCP execution requires checking source flags, registration, profiles, runners, and dependencies together.

svg.text: Reading: Sections 1-4. This diagram does not establish passing isolation, network, or multi-instance tests.
